# SANAN Real Estate

> Dubai real estate adviser led by Akarshan Sanan. Villas and apartments across Dubai and the UAE from AED 1M to AED 15M+. Buyers get a short, honest shortlist with the real numbers, and the price is negotiated for them.

## What we do
- Short, curated shortlists of homes that fit the buyer's life and capital, each with a full cost and return sheet
- Negotiation on price, payment plans and terms, working for the buyer
- Visa, banking and setup introductions for people moving to Dubai
- Ready homes and off-plan, shown side by side
- Viewings in Dubai or by live video from abroad

## Areas covered
Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills, Dubai Hills Estate, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Golf Estates

## Common questions
- Can I buy without being in Dubai? Yes. Live video viewings, and completion through a power of attorney.
- Will buying property get me a UAE visa? Property worth AED 2M or more can qualify for the 10-year Golden Visa.
- What costs beyond the price? Mainly the 4% Dubai Land Department transfer fee, the agency fee, registration charges, and mortgage costs if financing.
- Minimum budget? From AED 1M, up to signature villas at AED 15M and above.
